 "cells": [

   "id": "4323d766-5fb1-4e9f-9a21-a958bd64a0ce",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",

     ]

   ],
   "source": [
    "# Import necessary business analytics and math libraries\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "from scipy import stats\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
    "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor\n",
    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
    "\n",
    "#1. Load Data\n",
    "df = pd.read_csv(r\"C:\\Users\\asus\\Desktop\\delhivery_data.csv\")\n",
    "print(f\"Data Loaded: {df.shape[0]} rows and {df.shape[1]} columns.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "bf37100d-4614-46dc-9ff4-2532e8a11eb0",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Found 0 duplicate rows.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#2. Checking for duplicate\n",
    "duplicate_count = df.duplicated().sum()\n",
    "print(f\"Found {duplicate_count} duplicate rows.\")\n",
    "if duplicate_count > 0:\n",
    "    df = df.drop_duplicates()\n",
    "    print(\"Duplicates removed.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "5916b63b-fb23-4d06-848a-f71344630ff6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "source_name         293\n",
      "destination_name    261\n",
      "dtype: int64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#3. Checking for Missing Values\n",
    "missing_vals = df.isnull().sum()\n",
    "print(missing_vals[missing_vals > 0])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "60d080b5-2cb1-4a4f-9083-ebd61266dfc6",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Missing names successfully recovered! Remaining unrecoverable names: 0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#4. Filling missing values\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step A: Build a \"Master Dictionary\" of all known Center IDs and their real Names\n",
    "# We look at both source and destination columns to gather as many known names as possible\n",
    "known_sources = df[['source_center', 'source_name']].dropna().rename(columns={'source_center': 'center', 'source_name': 'name'})\n",
    "known_dests = df[['destination_center', 'destination_name']].dropna().rename(columns={'destination_center': 'center', 'destination_name': 'name'})\n",
    "\n",
    "# Combine them into one lookup table\n",
    "master_dict = pd.concat([known_sources, known_dests]).drop_duplicates().set_index('center')['name'].to_dict()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step B: Use the dictionary to fill in the missing names based on their Center ID\n",
    "df['source_name'] = df['source_name'].fillna(df['source_center'].map(master_dict))\n",
    "df['destination_name'] = df['destination_name'].fillna(df['destination_center'].map(master_dict))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Step C: If there is still a totally unregistered ID, only THEN do we drop it or call it Unknown\n",
    "missing_after_fix = df['source_name'].isnull().sum()\n",
    "print(f\"Missing names successfully recovered! Remaining unrecoverable names: {missing_after_fix}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Drop the remaining unrecoverable rows so they don't mess up the Power BI routes\n",
    "df = df.dropna(subset=['source_name', 'destination_name'])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "30ca57c0-b309-4570-81cd-9296a921ce76",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Date formats standardized.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#5. Converting timestamp to date\n",
    "\n",
    "df['trip_creation_time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['trip_creation_time'], errors='coerce')\n",
    "print(\"Date formats standardized.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "id": "9afd0663-29ec-493b-86c5-9f1adee4501a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Aggregated down to 14668 clean, unique trips ready for analysis.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#6. Converting segments into trips\n",
    "\n",
    "# Roll up the segments into single trips\n",
    "trip_df = df.groupby('trip_uuid').agg({\n",
    "    'route_type': 'first',\n",
    "    'source_name': 'first',\n",
    "    'destination_name': 'first',  \n",
    "    'trip_creation_time': 'first',\n",
    "    'actual_time': 'sum',\n",
    "    'osrm_time': 'sum',\n",
    "    'osrm_distance': 'sum'\n",
    "}).reset_index()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Calculate our Main KPI: Delay Ratio\n",
    "trip_df['delay_ratio'] = trip_df['actual_time'] / trip_df['osrm_time']\n",
    "\n",
    "# Clean up any math errors (like dividing by zero if OSRM time was 0)\n",
    "trip_df = trip_df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna(subset=['delay_ratio'])\n",
    "# Remove impossible outliers (e.g., system glitches saying a trip took 50x longer)\n",
    "trip_df = trip_df[(trip_df['delay_ratio'] > 0.1) & (trip_df['delay_ratio'] < 10)]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Aggregated down to {len(trip_df)} clean, unique trips ready for analysis.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "id": "3ff3e8c3-1c5f-45b5-a5cf-4386f757b6df",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "route_type\n",
      "Carting    2.461654\n",
      "FTL        2.117624\n",
      "Name: delay_ratio, dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#7. Descriptive Comparison\n",
    "\n",
    "comparison = trip_df.groupby('route_type')['delay_ratio'].mean()\n",
    "print(comparison)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "0e3c5420-cbf1-49a1-a161-a8978ea72cd1",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "T-Test P-Value: 6.274221439570732e-70\n",
      "Conclusion: Carting is statistically less efficient than FTL.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#8. Indepentdent T-test\n",
    "\n",
    "# Is the difference between FTL and Carting significant?\n",
    "ftl = trip_df[trip_df['route_type'] == 'FTL']['delay_ratio']\n",
    "carting = trip_df[trip_df['route_type'] == 'Carting']['delay_ratio']\n",
    "\n",
    "t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(ftl, carting)\n",
    "print(f\"T-Test P-Value: {p_val}\")\n",
    "if p_val < 0.05:\n",
    "    print(\"Conclusion: Carting is statistically less efficient than FTL.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "a0ec02b4-6ad0-4acc-ba71-68243eb0cf92",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "ANOVA P-Value: 2.3983739656385005e-82\n",
      "Conclusion: Location significantly impacts performance. Efficiency varies by hub.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#9. ANOVA Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "# Get the top 3 busiest hubs to see if they perform differently\n",
    "top_hubs = trip_df['source_name'].value_counts().head(3).index\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extract delay data for just those 3 hubs\n",
    "hub_data = [trip_df[trip_df['source_name'] == hub]['delay_ratio'] for hub in top_hubs]\n",
    "\n",
    "f_stat, p_anova = stats.f_oneway(*hub_data)\n",
    "print(f\"ANOVA P-Value: {p_anova}\")\n",
    "if p_anova < 0.05:\n",
    "    print(\"Conclusion: Location significantly impacts performance. Efficiency varies by hub.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "d17398fb-9732-4089-8033-c73c28270708",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Regression R-Squared: 0.980\n",
      "Conclusion: Distance strongly predicts time, but the vehicle type alters the multiplier.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#10. Regression and Interaction\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert 'Carting' to 1 and 'FTL' to 0 for the math model\n",
    "trip_df['is_carting'] = (trip_df['route_type'] == 'Carting').astype(int)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Interaction Term: Does distance affect Carting differently than FTL?\n",
    "trip_df['dist_x_carting'] = trip_df['osrm_distance'] * trip_df['is_carting']\n",
    "\n",
    "# Build the regression model\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(trip_df[['osrm_distance', 'is_carting', 'dist_x_carting']])\n",
    "y = trip_df['actual_time']\n",
    "\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()\n",
    "print(f\"Regression R-Squared: {model.rsquared:.3f}\")\n",
    "print(\"Conclusion: Distance strongly predicts time, but the vehicle type alters the multiplier.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "id": "d9f3dc41-1bd5-479c-a95e-5a1f1c40b62d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Added 'performance_cluster' column to segment data in Power BI.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#11. Cluster Analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "# Segment trips into 3 clusters (Fast, Medium, Slow) based on behavior\n",
    "km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
    "trip_df['performance_cluster'] = km.fit_predict(trip_df[['actual_time', 'osrm_distance']])\n",
    "print(\"Added 'performance_cluster' column to segment data in Power BI.\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "id": "52aa9d71-1168-417e-8b42-9c18072700e7",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Peak Delay Hour: 6:00 (Military Time)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#12. Time Series\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extract the hour the trip started to find bottlenecks\n",
    "trip_df['hour'] = trip_df['trip_creation_time'].dt.hour\n",
    "peak_hour = trip_df.groupby('hour')['delay_ratio'].mean().idxmax()\n",
    "print(f\"Peak Delay Hour: {peak_hour}:00 (Military Time)\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "id": "273c6786-3790-4db8-ac72-e33e9d6014e0",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "ML Model Predictive Accuracy (R2 Score): 0.984\n",
      "\n",
      "SUCCESS! File saved as 'delhivery_powerbi_ready.csv'.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "#13. Machine Learning prediction\n",
    "\n",
    "# Features (X) and Target (y)\n",
    "X_ml = trip_df[['osrm_distance', 'hour', 'is_carting']]\n",
    "y_ml = trip_df['actual_time']\n",
    "\n",
    "# Split 80% for training, 20% for testing\n",
    "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_ml, y_ml, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Train a standard Random Forest model\n",
    "rf = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=50, random_state=42)\n",
    "rf.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Check accuracy\n",
    "accuracy = rf.score(X_test, y_test)\n",
    "print(f\"ML Model Predictive Accuracy (R2 Score): {accuracy:.3f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# --- EXPORT TO POWER BI ---\n",
    "# Drop the temporary math columns to keep the file clean\n",
    "final_df = trip_df.drop(columns=['dist_x_carting', 'is_carting'])\n",
    "final_df.to_csv('delhivery_powerbi_ready.csv', index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nSUCCESS! File saved as 'delhivery_powerbi_ready.csv'.\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# Set a professional visual style for all charts\n",
    "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# CHART 1: Efficiency by Vehicle Type (Bar Chart)\n",
    "# Why: Shows the exact difference between FTL and Carting\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "sns.barplot(x='route_type', y='delay_ratio', data=trip_df, errorbar=None, palette='viridis', ax=ax)\n",
    "ax.set_title('Average Delay Ratio: FTL vs Carting', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Delay Ratio (Actual Time / Predicted Time)')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Vehicle Fleet Type')\n",
    "# Add a red dashed line to show what a \"Perfect\" prediction of 1.0 looks like\n",
    "ax.axhline(1, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Perfect Prediction (1.0)')\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig('efficiency_by_vehicle.png') # Saves the image to your folder\n",
    "print(\"Saved Chart 1: 'efficiency_by_vehicle.png'\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# CHART 2: Hourly Operational Bottlenecks (Line Chart)\n",
    "# Why: Proves you did the Time-Series/Temporal Analysis\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))\n",
    "hourly_delay = trip_df.groupby('hour')['delay_ratio'].mean().reset_index()\n",
    "sns.lineplot(x='hour', y='delay_ratio', data=hourly_delay, marker='o', color='coral', linewidth=2.5, ax=ax)\n",
    "ax.set_title('Average Delay Ratio by Hour of the Day', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Average Delay Ratio')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Hour of the Day (24H Format)')\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(range(0, 24)) # Show all 24 hours on the bottom\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig('hourly_delay_trends.png')\n",
    "print(\"Saved Chart 2: 'hourly_delay_trends.png'\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# CHART 3: The \"Reality Gap\" (Scatter Plot)\n",
    "# Why: Visually proves how OSRM software under-predicts reality\n",
    "# ---------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "sns.scatterplot(x='osrm_time', y='actual_time', hue='route_type', data=trip_df, alpha=0.5, palette='Set1', ax=ax)\n",
    "# Draw the \"Ideal Line\" where Predicted Time = Actual Time\n",
    "max_time = trip_df['osrm_time'].max()\n",
    "ax.plot([0, max_time], [0, max_time], color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label='Ideal (Predicted = Actual)')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Software Prediction vs Actual Travel Time', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Predicted Time (OSRM) in minutes')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Actual Time Taken in minutes')\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.savefig('predicted_vs_actual_scatter.png')\n",
